verses.text: Why, O LORD, do You stand far off? Why do You hide in times of trouble?

segments.text: Why, O LORD, do You stand far off? Why do You hide in times of trouble?

verses.text: In pride the wicked pursue the needy; let them be caught in the schemes they devise.

segments.text: In pride the wicked pursue the needy; let them be caught in the schemes they devise.

verses.text: For the wicked man boasts in the cravings of his heart; he blesses the greedy and reviles the LORD.

segments.text: For the wicked man boasts in the cravings of his heart; he blesses the greedy and reviles the LORD.

verses.text: In his pride the wicked man does not seek Him; in all his schemes there is no God.

segments.text: In his pride the wicked man does not seek Him; in all his schemes there is no God.

verses.text: He is secure in his ways at all times; Your lofty judgments are far from him; he sneers at all his foes.

segments.text: He is secure in his ways at all times; Your lofty judgments are far from him; he sneers at all his foes.

verses.text: He says to himself, “I will not be moved; from age to age I am free of distress.”

segments.text: He says to himself, “I will not be moved; from age to age I am free of distress.”

verses.text: His mouth is full of cursing, deceit, and violence; trouble and malice are under his tongue.

segments.text: His mouth is full of cursing, deceit, and violence; trouble and malice are under his tongue.

verses.text: He lies in wait near the villages; in ambush he slays the innocent; his eyes watch in stealth for the helpless.

segments.text: He lies in wait near the villages; in ambush he slays the innocent; his eyes watch in stealth for the helpless.

verses.text: He lies in wait like a lion in a thicket; he lurks to seize the oppressed; he catches the lowly in his net.

segments.text: He lies in wait like a lion in a thicket; he lurks to seize the oppressed; he catches the lowly in his net.

verses.text: They are crushed and beaten down; the helpless fall prey to his strength.

segments.text: They are crushed and beaten down; the helpless fall prey to his strength.

verses.text: He says to himself, “God has forgotten; He hides His face and never sees.”

segments.text: He says to himself, “God has forgotten; He hides His face and never sees.”

verses.text: Arise, O LORD! Lift up Your hand, O God! Do not forget the helpless.

segments.text: Arise, O LORD! Lift up Your hand, O God! Do not forget the helpless.

verses.text: Why has the wicked man renounced God? He says to himself, “You will never call me to account.”

segments.text: Why has the wicked man renounced God? He says to himself, “You will never call me to account.”

verses.text: But You have regarded trouble and grief; You see to repay it by Your hand. The victim entrusts himself to You; You are the helper of the fatherless.

segments.text: But You have regarded trouble and grief; You see to repay it by Your hand. The victim entrusts himself to You; You are the helper of the fatherless.

verses.text: Break the arm of the wicked and evildoer; call him to account for his wickedness until none is left to be found.

segments.text: Break the arm of the wicked and evildoer; call him to account for his wickedness until none is left to be found.

verses.text: The LORD is King forever and ever; the nations perish from His land.

segments.text: The LORD is King forever and ever; the nations perish from His land.

verses.text: You have heard, O LORD, the desire of the humble; You will strengthen their hearts. You will incline Your ear,

segments.text: You have heard, O LORD, the desire of the humble; You will strengthen their hearts. You will incline Your ear,

verses.text: to vindicate the fatherless and oppressed, that the men of the earth may strike terror no more.
